title: Tidewater Literacy Coalition — 2025 annual impact
audience: donors, board members, community partners at annual gala
core_points: Who we are: 14 volunteer-run reading rooms serving coastal families since 2011
Last year's reach: 9,412 kids tutored, 1,303 adult learners served, 48 school partnerships
Reading-level gain for 3rd-grade cohort: +1.4 grades over one school year of tutoring
Story we'll center: Mariela, who became a tutor herself after aging out of the program
Financial summary: $2.41M raised, 87 cents of every dollar goes directly to programs
Biggest program investment this year: bilingual early-reader workshop in three coastal counties
Volunteer hours logged: 51,800 — equivalent to 26 full-time staff we otherwise could not afford
New partnership: Pacific Public Library system for weekend tutoring space, no cost to us
Where your dollars went: 62% direct tutoring, 19% training, 13% books, 6% overhead
Next year's focus: reach 12,000 kids, launch family literacy nights, open rural satellite center
Ask: sustaining donors — monthly $40 keeps one tutoring slot open for a whole school year
